title: package.json
description: The manifest of a Node.js package: its name, version, scripts and dependencies.

person.description: A person who worked on the package: "Name <email> (url)", or an object.

email.description: The email address of the person.

dependencies.description: Package names, each with a version range, a tag, a URL, a path (file:) or a Git repository.

anyOf.description: The address of a page to fund the package.

type.description: The kind of funding: patreon, opencollective, github, individual…

name.description: The name of the package: lowercase, at most 214 characters, URL-safe, with an optional @scope/. It and the version identify the package in the registry.

version.description: The version of the package, which node-semver can read: major.minor.patch, with an optional pre-release (1.2.0-beta.1).

description.description: What the package does, shown by npm search.

keywords.description: Words that help people find the package with npm search.

homepage.description: The address of the website of the project.

bugs.description: Where to report problems: an address, or an object with the address and an email.

url.description: The address of the issue tracker.

license.description: The license of the package, as an SPDX expression (MIT, Apache-2.0, (MIT OR Apache-2.0)), or "UNLICENSED" for a private one.

author.description: The person who wrote the package: "Name <email> (url)", or an object.

contributors.description: The people who contributed to the package.

maintainers.description: The people who maintain the package.

funding.description: Where to fund the development of the package: an address, an object, or an array of them.

files.description: The files and folders (glob patterns) that go into the package when it is published.

main.description: The module that require() of the package loads, relative to the root of the package.

module.description: The ES module entry point, for bundlers.

browser.description: The entry point for browsers, or the modules to replace in a browser bundle.

type.description: How Node.js reads the .js files of the package: "module" for ES modules, "commonjs" (the default) for CommonJS.

exports.description: The entry points of the package, by path (".", "./utils") and by condition ("import", "require", "types", "default"…). Other modules of the package cannot be imported.

imports.description: Private imports of the package, whose names start with #.

types.description: The TypeScript declarations of the package (a .d.ts file).

typings.description: The TypeScript declarations of the package; the same as "types".

bin.description: The commands the package installs: a file, or command names with their file.

man.description: The manual pages of the package.

bin.description: The folder whose files are all commands.

man.description: The folder of the manual pages.

repository.description: Where the code lives: "github:user/repo", an address, or an object with its type and address.

directory.description: The folder of the package in a monorepo.

scripts.description: Commands to run with npm run <name>. Some run by themselves at a step of the life of the package (install, publish, test…); "pre" and "post" scripts run before and after the one they name.

dev.description: Starts the project for development, by convention.

start.description: Runs with npm start. Without it, npm start runs "node server.js".

restart.description: Runs with npm restart. Without it, npm restart runs stop then start.

prepare.description: Runs before the package is packed or published, and after npm install without arguments.

prepublishOnly.description: Runs before the package is prepared and packed, only on npm publish.

prepack.description: Runs before a tarball is packed (npm pack, npm publish, Git dependencies).

postpack.description: Runs after the tarball is made.

preinstall.description: Runs before the package is installed.

install.description: Runs when the package is installed.

postinstall.description: Runs after the package is installed.

preversion.description: Runs before npm version changes the version.

version.description: Runs after npm version changed the version, before the commit.

postversion.description: Runs after npm version made its commit.

config.description: Values the scripts read as npm_package_config_<key>.

dependencies.description: The packages the package needs to run.

devDependencies.description: The packages needed to develop and test the package, not installed with it.

peerDependencies.description: The packages the package works with, which the project that uses it installs (a plugin and its host).

peerDependenciesMeta.description: More about the peer dependencies, such as which are optional.

optional.description: The peer dependency may be missing.

optionalDependencies.description: Packages that are installed when they can be: their failure does not stop the installation.

bundleDependencies.description: The dependencies that go into the package when it is published.

bundledDependencies.description: The dependencies that go into the package when it is published; the same as "bundleDependencies".

overrides.description: Versions of dependencies of dependencies to use instead of the ones they ask for (npm).

resolutions.description: Versions of dependencies of dependencies to use instead of the ones they ask for (Yarn).

engines.description: The versions of Node.js (and of npm…) the package runs on.

node.description: The versions of Node.js, as a range: ">=18".

npm.description: The versions of npm, as a range.

os.description: The operating systems the package runs on (darwin, linux, win32…); one starting with ! is excluded.

cpu.description: The processors the package runs on (x64, arm64…); one starting with ! is excluded.

private.description: true keeps npm from publishing the package.

publishConfig.description: Settings used when the package is published.

access.description: Who can install a scoped package.

tag.description: The tag of the version published (latest by default).

workspaces.description: The folders (glob patterns) of the packages of a monorepo, installed together.

nohoist.description: The packages not hoisted to the root (Yarn).

packageManager.description: The package manager of the project and its version, for Corepack: "pnpm@9.1.0".

sideEffects.description: false when no module of the package has side effects, or the modules that have some: bundlers can leave the others out.
